checks.label: Automatic actions failing
checks.question: Are the system's automatic actions failing even after retries?
checks.warn_rule: 5 or more fail in an hour
checks.fail_rule: 20 or more fail in an hour, or any lead fails to reach Five9 or Lead Perfection
checks.business_impact: A lead that never reaches Five9 never gets called.

checks.label: Approvals waiting
checks.question: Is something waiting too long for a person to approve it?
checks.fail_rule: Waiting more than a day
checks.business_impact: Fixes and changes sit unapproved.

checks.label: Chatbot answering on time
checks.question: Is the chatbot answering customer texts quickly?
checks.fail_rule: Any customer text waits longer than the reply limit
checks.business_impact: Leads wait on the bot and go cold.

checks.label: Automation worker running
checks.question: Is the worker that carries out automatic actions running?
checks.warn_rule: It hasn't run for 3 minutes while work is waiting
checks.fail_rule: It hasn't run for 6 minutes while work is waiting
checks.business_impact: Nothing automatic gets done.

checks.label: Safety filter blocks
checks.question: Is the safety filter blocking far more messages than normal?
checks.warn_rule: More than 2 times a normal hour
checks.fail_rule: More than 5 times a normal hour
checks.business_impact: The bot may be misbehaving or someone may be trying to trick it.

checks.label: Daily AI spend
checks.question: Is today's AI spending within budget?
checks.fail_rule: Over the daily budget
checks.business_impact: A runaway process can spend a lot quickly.

checks.label: Automatic actions waiting
checks.question: Are automatic actions piling up or waiting too long?
checks.warn_rule: Oldest waits more than 15 minutes, or more than 50 are waiting
checks.fail_rule: Oldest waits more than 45 minutes, or more than 200 are waiting
checks.business_impact: Leads get routed late.

checks.label: Enough reps for tomorrow
checks.question: Does each office have enough reps for tomorrow's appointments in each time block?
checks.warn_rule: 1 more appointment than reps in a block
checks.fail_rule: 3 or more too many in one office block
checks.business_impact: Overbooked appointments go unrun.

checks.label: Confirmation calls made
checks.question: Did every unconfirmed appointment for tomorrow get at least one confirmation call today?
checks.fail_rule: Any not called by 7:00 PM
checks.business_impact: Replaces the hand count on the confirmation summary sheet.

checks.label: Customers entered twice
checks.question: Is any customer with an upcoming appointment entered twice in Lead Perfection?
checks.fail_rule: 20 or more
checks.business_impact: History gets split and the customer may be called twice.

checks.label: New inquiries waiting in Lead Perfection
checks.question: Are new inquiries waiting too long in Lead Perfection to be turned into leads?
checks.warn_rule: The oldest has waited 20 office minutes, or more than 10 are waiting
checks.fail_rule: The oldest has waited 45 office minutes, or more than 25 are waiting
checks.business_impact: An inquiry still waiting is on no calling list.

checks.label: Appointment times we don't book
checks.question: Is any appointment this week booked at a time we don't run (noon, 4 PM, or a sales-meeting morning)?
checks.warn_rule: Any appointment at a time we don't book
checks.fail_rule: Any booked by the chatbot or an automation (once dispatch confirms the rules)
checks.business_impact: An appointment nobody can run.

checks.label: Tomorrow's appointments issued by 8:15 PM
checks.question: Has every confirmed appointment for tomorrow been issued to a rep (reps can't see it otherwise)?
checks.fail_rule: Any not issued at 8:45 PM, or 3 or more at 8:15 PM
checks.business_impact: The rep never sees tomorrow's appointment.

checks.label: Issued appointments have a result
checks.question: Does every issued appointment from before yesterday have a result entered?
checks.fail_rule: 15 or more, or any older than 3 days
checks.business_impact: Missing results make the set, sit and close numbers wrong.

checks.label: Reps saw today's appointments
checks.question: Has every rep viewed today's appointments? (Lead Perfection doesn't share this yet.)
checks.fail_rule: Any not viewed at 8:30 AM
checks.business_impact: An unviewed appointment risks a no-show.

checks.label: Appointments have the required details
checks.question: Does every appointment set in the last day have its product, quantity and appointment type?
checks.warn_rule: 5 or more missing details in a day
checks.fail_rule: 15 or more in a day
checks.business_impact: Dispatch can't route an appointment without them.

checks.label: No new appointment on an issued lead
checks.question: Was a new appointment booked on a lead whose appointment was already issued?
checks.fail_rule: 3 or more in a day
checks.business_impact: It breaks lead-source tracking and rep stats.

checks.label: Tomorrow's appointments confirmed
checks.question: How many of tomorrow's appointments were still not confirmed at 7:15 PM?
checks.fail_rule: More than 30% not confirmed
checks.business_impact: Unconfirmed appointments are more likely to be no-shows.

checks.label: Tomorrow's appointments have a rep
checks.question: Does every confirmed appointment for tomorrow have a sales rep?
checks.warn_rule: Any without a rep at 7:30 PM
checks.fail_rule: Any without a rep at 8:15 PM
checks.business_impact: An appointment with no rep goes unrun.

checks.label: Call recordings reachable
checks.question: Can the system reach the call recordings to analyze calls?
checks.fail_rule: The recordings can't be reached
checks.business_impact: Phone calls aren't analyzed while the recordings can't be reached.

checks.label: Calling campaigns running
checks.question: Is every calling campaign that should be running actually running during calling hours?
checks.fail_rule: A campaign has been stopped for 10 minutes
checks.business_impact: If DIAL ASAP stops, no new lead gets called.

checks.label: No phone called more than 3 times a day
checks.question: Is any phone number being called more than 3 times in 24 hours?
checks.fail_rule: Any number called 5 or more times, or 10 or more numbers called 4 times
checks.business_impact: Customer experience and calling rules.

checks.label: Five9 settings unchanged
checks.question: Did any Five9 campaign, filter or list setting change since yesterday?
checks.fail_rule: A change to the DIAL ASAP or After DIAL ASAP settings
checks.business_impact: An unreviewed change alters who gets called and when.

checks.label: Unreached leads move to the follow-up list
checks.question: Do unreached DIAL ASAP leads move to the After DIAL ASAP follow-up list on their own?
checks.warn_rule: 3 or more missed in one pass
checks.fail_rule: 10 or more missed, or any waiting more than 2 hours
checks.business_impact: Second and third call attempts never happen.

checks.label: Dialing pace
checks.question: Are campaigns dialing at their normal pace for this time of day?
checks.fail_rule: Below 30% of normal, or no dials for an hour
checks.business_impact: Calling capacity quietly drops.

checks.label: New leads called within 15 minutes
checks.question: Did new DIAL ASAP leads get their first call within 15 minutes?
checks.warn_rule: Half of them took more than 10 minutes
checks.fail_rule: Any lead waited more than 30 minutes, or 3 or more waited more than 15
checks.business_impact: Calling fast is what books appointments.

checks.label: Leads on the right calling list
checks.question: Is each new lead on the Five9 calling list it should be on, in time?
checks.fail_rule: 3 or more late, or any very late

config.conf_rule: Conf - 2nd Day by 08:00 ET two days before; Conf - Next Day by 08:00 ET the day before

checks.business_impact: The wrong list means the wrong call schedule and a missed first call.

checks.label: Calling lists being worked
checks.question: Is a calling list with leads waiting going undialed while agents are ready?
checks.fail_rule: No dial in 60 minutes
checks.business_impact: A stalled DIAL ASAP list means every new lead is waiting.

checks.label: "No Demo" and Do Not Call leads not called again
checks.question: Is any lead marked No Demo, ND or Do Not Call still being called?
checks.fail_rule: 3 or more
checks.business_impact: Calling them is a complaint risk (ruled 2026-10-07).

checks.label: Five9 sending call activity
checks.question: Is Five9 sending any call activity at all?
checks.fail_rule: Quiet for much longer than usual
checks.business_impact: The whole dialer may be down.

checks.label: Unmapped leads called last
checks.question: Are unmapped leads being called while the regular lists still have leads? (Can't be measured yet.)
checks.warn_rule: Any unmapped call while a regular list has leads
checks.fail_rule: For an hour
checks.business_impact: Agents call the wrong leads.

checks.label: GHL workflows starting correctly
checks.question: Can an unpublished GHL workflow still start, or does one trigger start several workflows?
checks.fail_rule: Not used
checks.business_impact: Contacts end up in unfinished or duplicate workflows.

checks.label: Within GHL's request limit
checks.question: Are we staying within GHL's limit on requests?
checks.warn_rule: Close to the limit for 10 minutes
checks.fail_rule: Over the limit for 10 minutes
checks.business_impact: Every update to GHL is delayed.

checks.label: Automation rules reach live workflows
checks.question: Does every automation rule send contacts to a published GHL workflow?
checks.warn_rule: Any rule points at an unpublished workflow
checks.fail_rule: Any rule points at a workflow that doesn't exist
checks.business_impact: The rule fires and nothing happens.

checks.label: GHL sending updates
checks.question: Are updates from GHL still arriving at the usual volume?
checks.warn_rule: Under half the usual for 2 hours
checks.fail_rule: None for 2 hours during the day
checks.business_impact: New leads from GHL stop arriving.

checks.label: Background jobs failing
checks.question: Is any background job failing again and again?
checks.fail_rule: 3 failures in a row

config.note: promised-callback-sweep 163 fails/7d and rehash-tag-sweep 83/7d must be fixed or excluded before live (Gaps #11)

checks.business_impact: Automations silently stop.

checks.label: Background jobs running on time
checks.question: Has any background job stopped running on its schedule?
checks.warn_rule: Quiet for twice its normal gap
checks.fail_rule: Quiet for four times its normal gap
checks.business_impact: This is how the 47-hour outage went unnoticed.

checks.label: Appointments with no lead in Lead Perfection
checks.question: Was any appointment booked on a call for someone with no lead in Lead Perfection?
checks.fail_rule: 3 or more in a day
checks.business_impact: Lead Perfection can't dispatch it, so it becomes a no-show.

checks.label: Canvass leads delivered
checks.question: Did every canvass lead reach Lead Perfection and the dialer?
checks.fail_rule: 2 or more not delivered, or any after 2 hours
checks.business_impact: Canvassers are paid per lead; a dropped lead is a wasted door.

checks.label: Chat leads delivered
checks.question: Are chatbot and website chat leads reaching Lead Perfection?
checks.warn_rule: Any lead would have been missed
checks.fail_rule: Any lead failed to send
checks.business_impact: 18 a day were missing in September.

checks.label: How fast new leads were called yesterday
checks.question: How long did it take to call 9 in 10 of yesterday's new leads?
checks.fail_rule: More than 4 hours, or more than 3% never called
checks.business_impact: A slow first call lowers the booking rate for every source.

checks.label: Leads stuck waiting in Lead Perfection
checks.question: How many lost leads were simply never turned into leads in Lead Perfection?
checks.fail_rule: 10 or more
checks.business_impact: A people bottleneck, not an automation problem.

checks.label: GHL contacts that never became a lead
checks.question: Did every new GHL contact reach Lead Perfection within an hour? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: 3 or more in 2 hours
checks.business_impact: A contact that never reaches Lead Perfection is never called.

checks.label: Leads that never reached Five9
checks.question: How many leads never reached Five9 at all?
checks.fail_rule: More than 10 in a day, or worth more than $25,000
checks.business_impact: On Oct 14, 42 leads worth $94,000 landed here.

checks.label: Leads lost to routing problems
checks.question: How many leads were lost because routing or an automation failed?
checks.fail_rule: 3 or more
checks.business_impact: On Oct 14, 6 leads worth $8,800.

checks.label: Leads waiting for a first call
checks.question: Has every new lead from the last day had at least one call?
checks.warn_rule: Any lead waiting more than 30 minutes
checks.fail_rule: Any lead waiting more than an hour, or 3 or more waiting more than 30 minutes
checks.business_impact: A lead nobody called today is a lead a competitor calls.

checks.label: Scheduled n8n workflows ran
checks.question: Did every scheduled n8n workflow run on time? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: Late by four times its schedule
checks.business_impact: Report imports and weekly reports silently stop.

checks.label: n8n workflow errors
checks.question: Are n8n workflows failing? (Coming later.)
checks.warn_rule: 2 or more errors per workflow in an hour
checks.fail_rule: 5 or more, or any error on a lead intake workflow
checks.business_impact: On Oct 14 there were 10 errors in 3 hours.

checks.label: n8n up
checks.question: Is n8n answering?
checks.fail_rule: Missed twice in a row
checks.business_impact: All n8n automations stop.

checks.label: Dashboard up
checks.question: Is the dashboard loading?
checks.fail_rule: Not loading twice in a row
checks.business_impact: No one can see the command center.

checks.label: Five9 connected
checks.question: Can we connect to Five9?
checks.fail_rule: Missed twice in a row
checks.business_impact: We can't see or manage the dialer.

checks.label: HL-MCP up
checks.question: Is HL-MCP (our GHL connection) running?
checks.warn_rule: Slow, or its latest update failed
checks.fail_rule: Not answering twice in a row, or Railway shows it down
checks.business_impact: Nothing can update GHL.

checks.label: Lead Perfection connected
checks.question: Can we connect to Lead Perfection?
checks.fail_rule: Missed twice in a row
checks.business_impact: No new leads and no updates from Lead Perfection.

checks.label: LP-MCP up
checks.question: Is LP-MCP (the main system) running?
checks.warn_rule: Its latest update failed; the previous version is still running
checks.fail_rule: Down
checks.business_impact: Every job and safety net stops.

checks.label: Services running on Railway
checks.question: Are LP-MCP, HL-MCP, n8n and the dashboard running normally on Railway?
checks.warn_rule: Restarted 4 or more times in an hour, a failed update, or a service we can't see
checks.fail_rule: A service is down
checks.business_impact: A service is down or stuck restarting.

checks.label: Slack connected
checks.question: Can we post to Slack?
checks.fail_rule: Missed twice in a row
checks.business_impact: Alerts are silently lost.

checks.label: GHL copy database up
checks.question: Is the database that holds our copy of GHL answering?
checks.fail_rule: Not answering
checks.business_impact: Checks that read GHL data go blind.

checks.label: Main database up
checks.question: Is the main database answering?
checks.fail_rule: Not answering
checks.business_impact: Everything that stores or reads data stops.

checks.label: Test run: chatbot reply
checks.question: Does the chatbot answer a test message on time? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: No reply in time, or a wrong reply
checks.business_impact: The bot is down or broken.

checks.label: Test run: GHL to us
checks.question: Does a test update in GHL reach us within 2 minutes? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: Not seen within 2 minutes
checks.business_impact: GHL updates aren't reaching us.

checks.label: Test run: new lead to Lead Perfection
checks.question: Does a test contact become a Lead Perfection lead within 10 minutes? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: Any step fails or takes over 10 minutes
checks.business_impact: Proves the lead intake works without a real lead.

checks.label: Test run: Lead Perfection read
checks.question: Does Lead Perfection return a known test lead? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: Missed twice in a row
checks.business_impact: Catches an expired Lead Perfection login early.

checks.label: Test run: lead to the DIAL ASAP list
checks.question: Does the test lead reach the DIAL ASAP list within 5 minutes and get removed before any call? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: Not on the list within 5 minutes, or not removed within a minute
checks.business_impact: Proves leads get from Lead Perfection to Five9.

checks.label: Test run: n8n round trip
checks.question: Does a test n8n workflow answer within 2 minutes? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: No answer within 2 minutes
checks.business_impact: n8n can't reach the main system.

checks.label: Test run: Slack delivery
checks.question: Does a test Slack post arrive within 30 seconds? (Coming later.)
checks.fail_rule: Not seen within 30 seconds
checks.business_impact: Tells a quiet Slack from a broken one.

checks.label: Appointments match in Lead Perfection and GHL
checks.question: Do appointment times agree in Lead Perfection and GHL?
checks.fail_rule: 20 or more differences
checks.business_impact: Reps and the bot act on the wrong time.

checks.label: Five9 calls tied to leads
checks.question: What share of Five9 call records are tied to a Lead Perfection lead?
checks.fail_rule: Under 85%
checks.business_impact: Calls can't be matched to leads.

checks.label: Our copy of GHL is current
checks.question: Is our copy of GHL data up to date?
checks.warn_rule: Any part more than 30 minutes behind
checks.fail_rule: Contacts or opportunities more than 2 hours behind, or more than 5% of refreshes failing
checks.business_impact: Checks that read GHL data go blind.

checks.label: Lead Perfection sync errors
checks.question: Are new errors piling up when copying data from Lead Perfection?
checks.warn_rule: Any new error today, or old errors still open
checks.fail_rule: 10 or more new errors today, or more than 5 in the last hour
checks.business_impact: Leads that aren't copied are invisible to every check.

checks.label: New leads linked to GHL
checks.question: Is every new Lead Perfection lead linked to its GHL contact?
checks.fail_rule: Many unlinked
checks.business_impact: Unlinked leads get no follow-up messages and no chatbot.

checks.label: Lead Perfection leads copied recently
checks.question: Are leads being copied from Lead Perfection on time?
checks.fail_rule: Not copied for 45 minutes, or the last two tries failed
checks.business_impact: Every check reads old data.

checks.label: Lead Perfection reports arrived
checks.question: Did the daily Lead Perfection reports arrive (133 Jobs By Status, 134 Jobs by Milestone Date, 135 Lead Disposition Detail 2, 136 Mktg Sub-Source Cost Analysis 2, 137 Sales Efficiency By Mode)?
checks.fail_rule: Missing after 10:00 AM, or could not be read
checks.business_impact: The scorecard is missing a day.

checks.label: Old result codes not used
checks.question: Is an old, retired result code (like NIS2) showing up on new leads?
checks.fail_rule: 5 or more
checks.business_impact: Lost-lead reports quietly go wrong.

checks.label: Appointments with no result
checks.question: How many appointments from the last 14 days have passed with no result in Lead Perfection?
checks.fail_rule: 40 or more
checks.business_impact: The scorecard counts appointments that may not have happened.
